description: Edge cases for the ACI pilot data layer (reviewer findings C1-C2, M1-M9, m1-m6), applied on top of scenario.json in a later window and loaded as later index-time batches (edge/, then edge/late/). Every conversation id starts with ec-.

conversations.summary: C2: VM1 through the shop Gateway; Envoy on node-a forwards to frontend on node-a. A malicious header request on the same upstream connection must be dropped.

C2: VM2 through the same Gateway in the same bucket; Envoy on node-a forwards to frontend on node-b. VM2 sent X-Forwarded-For: 10.30.40.25 (spoofed leftmost); Envoy appended the real peer. A request naming a client with no conversation must be ignored.
